description: Implementation of NativeWindow11 using Win32 APIs for Direct3D 11, including swap chain creation and window management.

classes.name: NativeWindow11Win32
classes.description: Win32 implementation of NativeWindow11 for Direct3D 11 with optional DirectComposition support.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window, currently always returns true.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the client rectangle of the window.

methods.name: isIconic
methods.description: Checks if the window is minimized.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a DXGI swap chain with optional DirectComposition integration.

methods.name: commitChange
methods.description: Commits changes to the device if available.

methods.name: IsValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if a given native window handle is valid.
